fusions.name: Royal Rap
fusions.desc: A rap with the sceptre that deals 14 radiant damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Decree of Plenty
fusions.desc: Sends a decree that deals 28 radiant damage to the first enemy it meets. When it hits, you and every ally deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Table Command
fusions.desc: Every ally within 6 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds. You restore 10 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Bountiful Court
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you receive 40% more healing for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
